assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: District- and city-level statistics provide context only and are not downscaled to corridor, parcel, station or individual demand.
assumptions.impact: Scenario locations remain conceptual until official spatial datasets or cleared aggregated operator data are supplied.
assumptions.resolution: Verify dataset files, licenses, timestamps and spatial granularity; use privacy-preserving aggregation and professional review before placement decisions.
